name: Image to Image
intro: Image to Image in SmartVideo is an overview page where you can explore image editing models and example edits before opening the editor.

features.powerful-image-editing-cards: Four information cards summarize what is possible, from smart transformations and style transfer to professional tools like background removal.
features.available-models: The models grid shows featured editing models, so you can see which tools exist before you choose.
features.example-transformations: Example cards show ready made ideas with a model badge. Click Try this to get wording you can reuse in your own edit.
features.gtm-boost: The GTM Boost button opens a window where you describe your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and get a ready to use prompt.
features.start-editing: Start Editing opens Edit Studio, where you upload your image and begin your edit.
features.get-started-free: Get Started Free is the fastest way to the photo editing tools and opens Edit Studio.

outro: Browse the ideas, grab a prompt, and head into Edit Studio to turn your photo into something new.
